x: John Woodcock, a relatively newcomer to our midst, made his debut on the road at this distance ran a very creditable race and was our only 'B' team man to finish. - Glad to have you with us John, may it be the first of many.
Other promising runs so far have come from Adrian Major, John Woodcock, Colin Pearson, John Hamilton, Mark McNair, Jim Rimmer and youths Bill Curtin and Richard Langley.

Hence our scoring team became the 'old firm' of Lionel Mann and Pat O'Connor, showing a return to form, with another track man John Woodcock having only his 2nd road outing completing the trio with a truly fine run.

It was good to see John Woodcock back again after a period of studying, and Jack Hampshire having a go once again. But the boquet of the day goes to the man who won gold, Lionel Mann, for it was only 4 days earlier that he had placed third in the Belgrave 20 miles road race with a Club record time of 1:44:45!
